scripts.start:all: npm-run-all --parallel start:notifications start:stock-management start:gateway start:backend start:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix gateway && npm ci --prefix microservices/notifications && npm ci --prefix microservices/stock-management
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -p exam1-audit-test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.test.yml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from tests
scripts.lint: eslint backend gateway microservices docker && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend gateway microservices docker frontend/src frontend/vite.config.mjs frontend/index.html docker-compose*.yml
scripts.format: prettier --write backend gateway microservices docker frontend/src frontend/vite.config.mjs frontend/index.html docker-compose*.yml
